Regenerative Stem Cell Therapy & Pet Rehabilitation at Safari Veterinary Care Centers in League City, TX.

Stem Cells live in all tissues of the body and lay dormant until there is damage in need of repair.

The body’s natural repair process sends healing cells to the area of injury and directs these healing cells as to what needs to be done. In all cases these healing cells are stem cells. However, in many cases, the regenerative process is overwhelmed or exhausted or out of resources and healing is incomplete and that’s where regenerative medicine comes in.

Regenerative medicine strives to use the body’s own healing mechanisms, by adding Platelet Rich Plasma and/or stem cells we can restart the healing process which rejuvenates the damaged tissues and rebuilds damaged or missing tissues.

Stem Cells (don't heal, they) regenerate the original cartilage tissue just as it was when the animal was an infant.

Office: 281-332-5612
Hours: M-F: 6am-8am; Sat & Sun: 9am-6pm
